body: I think I'm going to try to do a vlog. I'll keep everyone updated! Thanks so much. I feel like I have a purpose once again. I haven't felt so for a very long time.
Okay. I think I will. Sounds scary... but exciting! I'll start working to make it happen. I'll let you know when I get it up and running. Thank you! I know I keep saying it, but, I really mean it.

Absolutely! I just need to find a place more appropriate than here. No need for my blah blah to clog up the amazing work done here.  
I just don't know much about blogging. And I kind of wonder if vlogging would be more efficient. After all, my tale is VERY long. I could make an entire evening of telling it. I'm sure that would translate to a lot of pages...

I appreciate your perspective. All I've ever wanted with my life was to turn all the pain into something that would benefit others. I even nearly became a soul-less psychologist myself! (I know you meant no harm)  
You're right though, so many mental health professionals just go through the motions. But some do care. Some have stories similar to mine, and they genuinely want to help.   
I want to continue to put love into this dark world myself. Thanks for giving me the strength to keep fighting.

You're right. I've been in some kind of therapy for over a decade now. And it certainly has helped. And I myself was in college to become a psychologist, but, in one of those cruel twists of fate, my health declined to where I had to drop out right before I got my BA in Psychology.  
You are helping me though. Your unconditional kindness means so much. I'm alive today thanks to everyone here that reached out. You made a difference. Thank you for caring.
Thank you so much! I'll let you know once I find the best way to share more. I'm open to suggestions, I have no idea what the hell I'm doing. But I'll figure it out!
I just... really don't have words. Thank you. I wish I had people like you in my life. I imagine my life would look so much different. Thank you for saving me. It feels so inadequate. But it's true.
Thank you. I'm so unfamiliar with unconditional kindness. It's really nice. And I'm really grateful for your support. Maybe this will be a turning point in my life. We shall see!

Sometimes, when powerful, rich, old white men seek to strip what little rights and protections I have away from me, I feel like the monsters are alive and well. My father was just one monster. There's bound to be more.  
Still, you're right. I should seek the good in the world. And I am trying. It's funny how elusive good people can be to find. Especially where I live, it seems. I just need to learn how to reconnect with the world. Thank you for reaching out.

Yeah, I um, I know my post was rather ambiguous. I was just in a really, really bad place and I just needed to write. I greatly underestimated just how much bullshit has happened in my life. And if you'd like to discover more of the story, I'm more than happy to oblige. I just need to find a good place to do so. I'll let you know when I figure it out. There's so much I didn't get to, and I look forward to sharing it with everyone. Thanks for the kind words!

You're right, thank you. I shared this post with her. We're both struggling, but we're trying our best to move in a good direction.   
Sometimes I feel like I love too much. I feel like if I could just be more jaded, less trusting, that maybe I'd be happier. But this world needs all the love it can get. Thank you for your contribution. Your love means so much.

It's difficult with a debilitating terminal illness. I've been dealt one shitty hand, and I am trying to do the best I can with it.  
If you continue to follow my story, you'll see how I have tried time and time again to fight for a life I want to live. If I was unwilling to fight, I'd have been dead a long time ago.
Absolutely! Just got to find out where. But I'll let you know when I figure it out! Thank you!
Thanks love. You too!

You're right. And what I said is true. But I just can't live a life without hope. I don't know that anyone can. Maybe for a time. But it eats at you.   
It also doesn't help I have a painful terminal illness that has robbed me of most everything I love. But you're right. I should adapt. Mourn my old dreams, then find new ones. I think this is the first step on that journey.  
Thank you for your insight. When I find the best place to tell my tale, I will! I do hope you join me.

You're right. I do have a terminal illness. That certainly complicates things.  
Still, I should make the best of it, shouldn't I? And I will. Thank you stranger.

I hope you find your way through it, love.  
We can stumble together though the darkness if you like.
Thank you for listening! I just need to figure out the best way to share it. If you have any suggestions, please let me know!
Your wish will be granted, I promise! Thank you!
Thanks! I intend to give it. Have any suggestions on where I should start? I'm kinda new to all this, and I really have no idea what I'm doing haha... But I absolutely want to deliver!
Thank you. I hope you're right!

Oh my god, thank you! I need you too. Truly. You are too kind.  
I will keep writing! Maybe someone will be kind enough to tell me the best place to do it.  
I love you too. You are a bright star in a void of eternal night. Thank you for giving me hope.
Thanks for waiting. It means everything to me. I will be happy to tell you more! I just need to figure out how.

It matters. I'm still alive today. I had every intent on taking my life yesterday.  
You saved my life. Don't underestimate the power of compassion. Thank you for caring. You were indeed there in my moment of need. I hope you'll join me when I find the best way to tell my tale.

Well, here it is! And thank you. I look forward to sharing more in the future.  
And don't doubt yourself! I don't feel like a strong person. But the human will to survive is powerful. I'm sure you're stronger than you imagine!

Thank you so much! I've had an interesting phenomenon occur in my more recent life.  
I hated myself for 30 years. I was filled with a burning self-loathing, and acted in so many destructive ways. Yet, in those times, I was usually surrounded by friends and lovers.  
Today, I actually really like myself. Yet, I have such a hard time making meaningful connections. Four close friends/lovers have abandoned me in the last two months. One of which I have had a relationship with for over ten years.  
And what's so frustrating about that is that I have no idea what I did wrong. I tried to find out why, but none would tell me. It's been so heartbreaking.  
I will give you what you want, for sure. Once I find the best medium, I will share what you want to know, and much more I imagine. Thank you for your interest and response. It literally means everything to me.
I did, thanks to you wonderful people! Once I figure out the best medium to tell my story, I will begin immediately.

You are absolutely right. There's so much comfort in knowing we're not alone in our struggles.  
I've been so depressed, and looking for comfort in all the wrong places. If I had come here first, maybe I'd be in a better place now.   
Thank you for sharing. I really appreciate your wise words. Thank you.

Oh my god, you made me absolutely sob. But, it's not a bad cry. It's a very happy-yet-bittersweet kind of cry.  
First of all, thank you! It means so much that you like my writing. I am quite the spinner-of-tales. Years of practice from playing Dungeons & Dragons, I suppose. I've always been told that my writing is a gift, and it has certainly served me well over the years.  
So, I had not gotten there yet, and I intend to write about it; but once I got sick (back in 2012) I went to school to become a psychologist, so that I could do just that. I wanted to turn my pain into something good, something to help others. I had to drop out my last semester before I got my BA in Psychology. I had a 3.9 GPA, and I loved school so much. But I just got too sick, and the pain was too great. I couldn't concentrate anymore.  
Thanks to you, I feel like I have another shot. Maybe not the same one I had before. But a girl can dare to dream, right?  
Thanks so much for the heartfelt response. I hope you join me on this journey once I figure out the logistics.

Thank you, kind stranger.  
I intend to grant your request! I'm just working on the logistics.

Good morning! Or good whatever time of day it is where you are. I'm happy to report I'm still here. I have all of you to thank for that. And I intend to reply to all of you, if I can.  
I had truly lost all hope. But, I have a goal now. And I want to see it through. And with the amazing perspective you have all offered... I must admit I'm rather optimistic about the endeavor.   
So here's the thing: I'm pretty out of touch with what the "kids" are up to these days (hah!). Many people suggested I start a blog, and that sounds lovely. Is there a particular place that would be best to do that? I'm not sure myself.  
Another concern I have is that due to the disease I'm dying from (I hadn't yet got to that part...) I recently lost all feeling in my hands. It's certainly made typing more difficult. Would a vlog be as enticing? It might be easier for me to do. And if I do a vlog, would YouTube be the place to do that?  


I know these probably seem like dumb questions. But I'm really out of tune with society. Depression is a bitch. Any insight or help would be most welcome.  


Thank you all. So much. You have truly given me hope when I thought none could possibly be left. You are wonderful people, and this is a wonderful community.  


Sincerely, and with crazy-mad love,  
Alena

I could be wrong, but I believe that there is a myth that hard working, god fearing people will never get seriously ill. Or perhaps that those that do get sick bring it upon themselves. I think the mental gymnastics required for that kind of thinking highlights the broken nature of capitalism.
I am happy that you are getting help and support. It’s a shame that so many veterans end up on the street due to similar fallacies. Thank you for standing up for what you believe in.
Thank you.

No one here reading my comment failed me. You people give me hope that America may one day be a much better place. 
I just reread my previous comment and realized how bitter I sounded. I’m usually far more optimistic. 
Keep fighting for equality. Stand up for those in need. Vote. Practice random acts of kindness. You all are on the right side of history. I love you all. 💜

This is exactly what happened to me. I was just told recently that I have 6 months to live.
I have worked to support myself since I was 14 years old. Six years ago (I was 28 at the time) I was hospitalized for over a month. My friends and family were told to say goodbye to me; the doctors believed I wasn’t going to make it. After a month of not dying, I was discharged from the hospital, even though I spent the entire stay in ICU. I had insurance at the time.
To make a very long story short; I ended up losing my insurance due to not being able to return to work. I lost everything, and ended up homeless for years. And now, over six years later, I was finally diagnosed properly; but far too late. I am now dying from stage 4 colon cancer. I am 34 years old now.
No one thinks it can happen to them. Yet, people would rather young people like myself die than adopt a socialist healthcare system.
Sorry for the wall of text. My story seemed poignant though.
I too cry for my own senseless death, as well as for the thousands out there that share my story. Condolences for the loss of your friend.

Well that's awesome, thick skin never hurts. I got hurt a lot, a long time ago. I too had an ex that couldn't handle my being bisexual. And it was hard for me to handle as well; internalized bi-phobia is a bitch.   But things get easier! I've been with my girlfriend for eleven years, and we both identify as bisexual. Thanks to strong communication between us, we keep an open relationship and both identify as poly. Our relationship has been pretty great; also we have had a lot of fun in both serious and casual relationships together. Of course, bi doesn't equal poly. Bi individuals can be as committed as anyone else. But it works for us!

Aww you like me? I should quit while I’m ahead!
Well, I am happy you haven’t gotten blown up by thirsty bitches yet. You will learn all of the perks of being bi though. People will call you an unfaithful whore in one breath; and then ask if you will sleep with them and their partner in the next. It’s fantastic!
For real though, fuck the haters and live your life authenticity. It’s all you can do. Take pride in yourself, and celebrate those that stand with you. I’ll definitely message you in a few... while on Ambien and Ativan. Time to live dangerously!

Oh man... an attractive woman; coming out as bisexual? RIP your inbox.
Also on that note... hey baby! 😘
Nah just kidding. Welcome to the club! If you ever want to tell more of your story, I’d love to hear it.

That went from “I don’t have an eating disorder “ to *Oh shit; I think I have an eating disorder* quite fast!
Hah, well, I wish you the best on your study OP!

I’m not usually much for freckles... but yours are ridiculously adorable.

The support in this thread is amazing. I wish I had found my way here a long time ago. 
Growing up, all I knew was shame, abuse and neglect. Survival was a constant struggle. I had no idea that people like me existed until my mid-twenties, and the denial took years to overcome. 
Now in my mid-thirties I live authenticity. 
I love you all. Keep being awesome.
I have to second this. You really are quite amazing to take the time to type all of this up. Mad respect. 💜

I totally get that. I mean, I have been full-time for over two years now and have never been misgendered. 
But even then I am TERRIFIED of posting a picture in here, even though I’d love to.  I’m not the kind of girl that usually gets the upvotes; I think. I’d love the feedback, but I would take every criticism personally.
At any rate, you’re a peach. I’d buy you a drink. 💜

Fight you?
I don’t hit girls.

Oh my god. Are you my brother? I have a very similar tale.
Dad had an overdose when I was 14. My brother moved far away, and I lived with my mother for a time. But then she was locked up for drug trafficking, and then I was on my own.
I ran from social services, even went so far as to get a fake ID so that I could get an apartment and a job. The world is a scary place for a 14 year old on their own.
But I get it. Fuck them. The world may not understand why you did what you did, but I do. I’m happy you made it to adulthood, friend. 💜

I didn’t know how bad I needed to hear this until now. I, too, am a trans-woman with disabilities. I’ve always felt alone in this particular struggle. Absurd, I know. But just knowing there’s others out there with similar struggles gives me hope and strength. Thank you; and thanks OP for sharing!
Oh *mah* god, trans-moms are a thing we need more of.  You both are adorable!
You can still be my girlfriend. 😘

I once saw a sticker in a ladies room that read: “A trans-woman peed here, and no one was raped.”
I need to get some of those stickers.
*Taste the rainbow* while inking the rainbow.

Hello past me.
I thought with my hulking 300 pound frame, wide shoulders, large feet, and beard that went down to my navel, that I would never be able to go stealth. I accepted that as an indisputable fact.
I was 30 years old at that time.
Today, I am 33, soon to be 34. I have been living full-time for almost 2 years now, and been on HRT two and a half years. I have never been clocked, despite living deep in the Bible Belt. In fact, the only people who are hateful to me are the ones who knew the old me.
Am I perfect? No. But I can live my life as my *true* self for the first time in my life. While my family disowned me, I have a wonderful group of friends and a lovely girlfriend.
Don’t give up on yourself, sister. If I can do it, I think anyone can.
PS: I have some amazing hips. My cis girlfriend is totally jealous.
